answer: Applicants lock 27 POA in a quartz vault for 14 days and publish a thread of five 32-byte preimages, revealing one every 6 hours as SHA-256(preimage||address). A second identity is rejected if any reveal hash collides or if two reveals arrive under 5 hours 40 minutes apart. In the 48-hour dune audit that follows, a proven collision slashes 16 POA and freezes the rest 30 days; a missed reveal burns 8 POA. Only a complete, unflagged thread unlocks the quartz vault after the dune audit closes.
